text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Passing by the dance studio, I happen to see Yamanin Zephyr inside by herself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hah! Hup!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hm… It still doesn't feel right…
choice_data_list: Your dancing didn't look bad to me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer… And yet, the turbulent winds in my heart won't calm down.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: As one accustomed to melodies carried by the wind and the swaying of the trees, the music and dances of people feel… strange.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No matter how the wind blows, the lyrics and choreography of this song remain unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Even if the melody creates discord with the winds of the moment, the performance must go on, against nature…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It's… difficult for me, if not quite as bad as a frosty gale in summer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Being the free spirit that she is, conforming to a set dance routine may feel uncomfortable. But there's no opting out of a class assignment…
choice_data_list: Sometimes, you need to ride the headwind, too.
Why not summon a wind that suits the music?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …The headwind?
choice_data_list: Not every wind will blow to your liking.
Not every wind will blow to your liking.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That is… very true.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Nature is unpredictable. Sometimes, just when you think a benison breeze is blowing your way, you're confronted with a storm.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, a headwind is simply another kind of wind—which means I must adapt and learn to ride it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Read the wind and adapt… Yes, that encapsulates what living amidst nature is about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Convinced by her own reflections on the topic, Yamanin Zephyr resumes her practice with quiet determination.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by "summon"?
choice_data_list: I mean you should practice with someone whose wind suits the song.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her talk about the winds just now may be referring to her own feelings or the mood of the place. If that's the case, getting someone else involved might help.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I see… Well, if I'm looking for someone to help with this song, then…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'd like you to perform with me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: In the past, I've felt a fair wind blowing my way while in your company.
choice_data_list: I can't take your test with you, though.
I can't take your test with you, though.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: There's no rule that says you can't. Join me, and let's summon the wind together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, Yamanin Zephyr and I sing and dance together as her teacher watches on with a forced smile.
